messages:
Maya: Pushed a new Figma frame for a "Spend Insights" card — org vs project toggle, stacked visualization, and a small invoice preview panel. PTAL: https://figma.com/sample-link . Main question: which default scope and token breakdown granularity should we use?
Rahul: Love the direction. Default to Org view for billing admins, but keep a clear Project tab. Persist last-used scope so product teams don't flip it every time.
Linh: From FE perspective stacked bar (by month) is much lighter to render/animate than stacked area. Also we should consider moving legend inside the chart to save vertical real estate.
Oscar: Data note — we can break tokens into Prompt / Response / Embedding / Rerank, but dashboard bins must match upstream billing aggregation to avoid confusion. Need a mapping table.
Priya: UX warning: too many toggles will overwhelm. Suggest compact controls: Scope: [Org | Project] and Granularity: [Monthly | Daily], plus an "Advanced" dropdown for further breakdowns.
Gabe: Finance request: CSV export with token columns and invoice_id mapping is mandatory. Also invoice preview should show linked invoice id + a direct "View invoice" link.
Maya: Copy tweak proposal: change "Estimated spend" → "Estimated billed spend (USD)" and tooltip: "Estimate based on recorded usage and your pricing tier; final amounts appear on invoices." Thoughts?
Linh: Accessibility/Q: proposed color palette uses subtle blues that might fail contrast for small text in the legend. a11y-bot, can you run a quick check on the palette referenced in the figma?
a11y-bot: Auto-scan result: primary mid-blue (#4B7BD3) passes AA for large text but fails for normal text contrast. Recommendation: increase contrast or use patterns for fills. Also ensure keyboard focus on chart points and aria-describedby on tooltips.
Oscar: For colorblind-safe rendering we can add patterned fills for each token type and a high-contrast fallback. I'll attach SVG samples in the figma comments.
Priya: Microcopy for invoice mapping: add a subtle note under the export: "Charges shown are estimates until final invoice generation." Keep it short.
Gabe: Also ensure exported rows include billing_account_id and project_id for reconciliation with our finance systems. Example CSV header we expect:
```invoice_id,billing_account_id,project_id,date,tokens,cost_usd```
Rahul: Rollout plan idea: behind feature flag `spend_insights_v2`. Start 5% orgs, with opt-in for admins to preview. Monitor mismatches between dashboard and invoice totals closely during ramp.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll update the frames to stacked bar default, compact controls, and the new copy. Question — anyone opposed to moving legend inside chart (overlay) vs keeping it as a separate sidebar?
Linh: Not opposed, but we may need a sticky legend for long time ranges so users don't lose context when scrolling.
Gabe: +1 on sticky legend. Also add an "Export invoice mapping" button next to the CSV export for quick reconciliation pulls.
Maya: Thanks — I'll iterate and tag folks on updated frames. @Rahul can you add the feature-flag ticket to the sprint so Eng has the context for rollout?
Rahul: Yep will create the ticket and include acceptance criteria: CSV columns, invoice link, a11y checklist, and rollout percentage.
Maya: Great — will follow up with a short design handoff doc. Thanks everyone!
